expectations.description: States the practical consequence: undetected local dependence inflates item information functions and biases person parameter (theta) estimates
expectations.evidence: The response explicitly states: 'Even a few pairs with high LD can inflate reliability estimates and bias θ̂ (person parameter) precision' and in the bottom line section: 'Overestimated precision (underestimated SEs) if local dependence is present' and 'Biased θ̂ estimates if a meaningful secondary dimension exists'. This directly addresses both consequences: LD inflating item information (overestimated precision/underestimated SEs) and biasing person parameter estimates (biased θ̂).
